name: k8s/v1.29
scope_note: High-frequency defaulting subset only (10 rules); NOT a complete Kubernetes defaulting table. Unmatched paths are compared structurally and reported as degraded.

rules.source: K8s 1.29 pkg/apis/core/v1/defaults.go SetDefaults_Container: tag=="latest" -> Always, else -> IfNotPresent; pkg/util/parsers/parsers.go ParseImageName turns an absent tag into "latest". Condition is required, not cosmetic: a container whose image is :latest (or untagged) is defaulted to Always by the API Server, so filling IfNotPresent there would cancel a real difference.

K8s 1.29 pkg/apis/core/v1/zz_generated.defaults.go: ContainerPort.Protocol == "" -> "TCP" (generated from the ContainerPort defaulting func; behavior pinned by pkg/apis/core/v1/defaults_test.go case "ContainerPort"). Unconditional.
K8s 1.29 pkg/apis/core/v1/zz_generated.defaults.go: ContainerPort.Protocol == "" -> "TCP" (same defaulting func as the Deployment path, applied to a bare Pod's container list). Unconditional.
K8s 1.29 pkg/apis/core/v1/defaults.go SetDefaults_PodSpec: nil -> DefaultTerminationGracePeriodSeconds; the constant is 30 in k8s.io/api core/v1/types.go. Unconditional.
K8s 1.29 pkg/apis/core/v1/defaults.go SetDefaults_PodSpec: empty -> RestartPolicyAlways. Unconditional.
K8s 1.29 pkg/apis/core/v1/defaults.go SetDefaults_PodSpec: empty -> DNSClusterFirst. Unconditional.

NOTE: this is an admission-plugin default, not registry defaulting -- it materializes only when the ServiceAccount admission plugin is enabled (it is in default kube-apiserver installs).
